name: Merlin
source:
A legendary wizard who has served the castle for generations. His incredible power and prophetic actions draw the heroine's attention...except the lion's share of his time is more devoted to mocking pickup lines and naughty behavior. Truly a man of mystery.

"If you won't run, I'll just tackle you to the floor right here and now, you know."

[From in-game profile]
